recommendations.title: Refresh: Add a clear price table for common villa system sizes
recommendations.details: Add a simple, prominent table to the existing pricing pages that lists common system sizes (e.g. 5, 7, 10 kW), price before tax and subsidies, price after grönt avdrag, and a short line-item summary of what is included (panels, inverter, installation, commissioning, VAT). Include a note about variance by roof complexity and region. Keep assumptions visible (kWh per kWp, fixed-price assumption for calculation).
